items.name: Solivio pattern

items.name: auto proposal

items.name: auto budget
items.reason: Budget preparation is plan-only; no price mutation, commitment or money movement is authorized.

items.name: DocuSeal
items.reason: Signature benchmark only. Any real signature execution remains SIGNATURE_REQUIRED and no external DocuSeal call or dependency is activated.

items.name: Oreko

items.name: Stripe
items.reason: Stripe is treated only as an existing integration seam to wrap; credentials and charges are not accessed and no payment execution authority is granted.

items.name: invoice / receipt
items.reason: Invoice/receipt preparation composes existing INV-001/ACC-001, but fiscal issue remains LEGAL_REQUIRED and no invoice is issued in this scope.

items.name: product delivery
items.reason: The existing AION/Product Factory capability must be reused rather than duplicated; the repository live adapter seam still requires audit before any real delivery side effect.

items.name: post-purchase email
items.reason: Post-purchase email is represented as a COM-001 intent only; external dispatch remains disabled until a governed delivery adapter is verified.
